mission: XRP ecosystem intelligence; institutional stablecoin rails, actual-capital accounting, SBI and Circle relationship graph

sources.publisher: SBI Holdings / SBI Shinsei Trust Bank / SBI VC Trade
claims: JPYSC issuance balance was approximately JPY 20.1B as of 2026-09-07.
JPYSC Lending applications were approximately JPY 6.9B; SBI described issuance plus lending as approximately JPY 27B handled scale.
JPY 1B of JPYSC trust assets began being invested in short-term Japanese government bonds.
The 2026-06-01 legal change permits, subject to requirements, up to 50% of issuance backing in government securities with remaining maturity no longer than three months or term deposits.
limitations: The JPY 1B is an initial disclosed allocation, not the entire reserve portfolio.
The figures are dated 2026-09-07 and must not be presented as 2026-11-02 balances.
The press release does not establish XRP purchases or XRP settlement.

claims: SBI defines handled balance as on-chain balance plus lending balance.
JPYSC Lending is a customer-to-SBI VC Trade token-lending product, not a customer borrowing-against-collateral product.
limitations: The release does not provide a synchronized public-chain circulating-supply snapshot.
Handled balance is not equivalent to publicly transferable supply or net external settlement.

claims: Circle and ACI announced a collaboration to demonstrate USDC settlement integrated into existing banking and payment infrastructure.
The initial focus is Colombia and ACI Connetic.
ACI says it built central infrastructure powering Bre-B, Colombia's interoperable instant-payment ecosystem.
The initiative is framed as evaluation and demonstration of stablecoin settlement alongside existing rails.
limitations: No production settlement volume, active bank count, corridor value, fees or on-chain chain allocation is disclosed.
A collaboration/pilot announcement is not evidence of live commercial throughput.

claims: Circle scheduled Q3 2026 results for 2026-11-04 at 8:00 a.m. Eastern.
Circle identifies its investor site, pressroom, webcast and filings as disclosure channels.
limitations: No Q3 results are available in this cutoff; do not infer the results.

relationship_edges.to: SBI VC Trade / SBI Shinsei Trust Bank

relationship_edges.relationship: USDC settlement integration collaboration for Colombia
ACI platform supports the central infrastructure described by ACI for Colombia's instant-payment ecosystem
founding validator participation, previously disclosed by Circle
longstanding strategic/equity and commercial relationships, distinct from JPYSC reserve ownership
possible competing or complementary payment-rail exposure only; no direct integration found

jpysc_2026_09_07.note: SBI's issuance balance and customer lending balance are separate accounting categories. Do not add lending applications to public on-chain supply.

jpysc_2026_11_02.note: These are company-reported product balances, not XRP flows or publicly circulating JPYSC supply.

circle_aci_colombia.note: The announced initiative has no disclosed realized settlement volume at this cutoff.

competing_hypotheses.statement: USDC settlement embedded in existing Colombian payment infrastructure could compete with XRP as an intermediary/bridge asset on some corridors.
support: Circle and ACI explicitly announced a USDC settlement initiative focused on Colombia and Bre-B.
disconfirming_or_limits: The announcement describes demonstration/evaluation, not production volume.
No XRP route-level settlement baseline or bank adoption count is available.

competing_hypotheses.statement: USDC could complement rather than displace XRP by serving as a stable settlement leg while XRP remains useful for liquidity bridging on other routes.
support: Circle says ACI Connetic supports an evolving ecosystem of payment networks and digital-asset providers.
USDC is already available on XRPL in the previously documented relationship graph.
disconfirming_or_limits: No ACI-XRPL or ACI-XRP integration is disclosed.
No matched-corridor flow data is available.

competing_hypotheses.statement: JPYSC reserve investment in short-term JGBs ties the yen stablecoin's backing economics to Japanese short-term sovereign yields and liquidity management.
support: SBI disclosed an initial JPY 1B short-term JGB allocation and the applicable maturity/percentage constraints.
disconfirming_or_limits: The disclosed allocation is only a dated initial tranche.
No current full reserve composition, duration, yield or liquidity ladder is disclosed.

competing_hypotheses.statement: SBI's participation in Ripple-related businesses, Circle/Arc and JPYSC/OUSD interoperability indicates multi-network strategic optionality rather than exclusive commitment to one settlement rail.
support: SBI has separate Ripple relationships, Circle Arc participation and JPYSC development; SBI and Startale announced exploration of JPYSC/OUSD interoperability.
disconfirming_or_limits: These relationships may be siloed by subsidiary, customer segment and regulatory perimeter.
No consolidated SBI capital-allocation or route-volume disclosure is available.

unknowns: ACI/USDC pilot production status, participating banks, settlement volumes, fees, FX corridors, chains and customer flows.
Whether any Colombian Bre-B bank routes currently use XRP or XRPL.
JPYSC reserve composition after 2026-09-07, including total JGB share, maturities, counterparties and reserve liquidity.
Synchronized 2026-11-02 JPYSC on-chain supply versus SBI VC Trade lending balance and redemption obligations.
Whether JPYSC has moved to public-chain distribution or Arc/StableFX deployment.
Whether Circle's ACI initiative creates measurable USDC demand that substitutes for, or complements, XRP bridge liquidity.

forecast.reason: No verified corridor-level production volumes, synchronized JPYSC reserve series or calibrated XRP model evidence were obtained. These developments are institutional feature candidates, not directional price signals.

next_actions: Reconcile the November 2 JPYSC handled balance against on-chain supply and customer lending definitions.
Track JPYSC reserve disclosures and short-term JGB allocations without treating the statutory 50% ceiling as actual allocation.
Monitor ACI/Circle for named bank pilots, production launch dates and realized USDC settlement volume.
Search for matched Colombia payment corridors with independently sourced XRP/XRPL usage before testing substitution hypotheses.
Add policy-rate, JGB yield and USD/JPY features with point-in-time publication timestamps.
